forecasts.reason: Forward-only recalibration costs ~0.03-0.08 s; the trajectory is unchanged, so the paired delta is small (+0.05±0.12 pp) and unlikely to clear +0.15.
~69 extra small steps pay fixed Muon/launch overhead (+0.2-0.4 s); accuracy gain plausible but noisy from the RNG re-draw.
33% more steps; the fixed per-step overhead makes time rise ~9%, well beyond H5.1.2's +4% cap, even if accuracy rises.
Saves ~0.008 s on each of ~23 steps; past freezes cost 0.05-0.2 pp, so the ≤0.1 pp test is hard to resolve.
Diagnostic; Cin=24 is a multiple of 8, so whether conv1 runs below half the group-2 throughput is close to a coin flip.
11 fewer steps ≈ -0.2 s plus topk overhead; at E031's rate the loss is ~-0.15 pp, more than the 0.1 pp allowed.
Cin=24 is already 8-aligned for fp16 tensor cores; expect a saving under 2%, and kernel changes may move rounding slightly.

cruxes: How much fixed time does each optimizer step cost (Muon Newton-Schulz plus launches), compared with the work that scales with batch size? This decides whether any batch-size change (I068, I069, H5.1.x) can pay for itself.

Does recomputing BN statistics after the final Lookahead average give a paired gain of at least 0.1 pp? It is the only candidate that adds accuracy without changing the training run, so it decides whether any time cut becomes affordable.

Does the profiler (I071) show group-1 conv1 and the 31×31 memory-bound kernels taking well over their FLOP share? That decides whether alignment fixes like I073 and further partial freezes still have value.
structured_output.world_model: W3 (cost lens), after E042. Tip E036: 5.314 s; population mean ≈0.7528, so there is zero margin. Time ≈ 0.25 s + Σ per-step cost; each step pays a fixed Muon/launch cost of about 0.003-0.005 s, so smaller batches cost more than the work they save. Every trim since E036 has lost 0.05-0.2 pp (about 1-2.5 s per pp). Funders: only the trajectory-neutral BN recalibration remains plausible (prior +0.05±0.12 pp). Systems levers are small (<2%). The stem must stay trainable until about 70-75% of steps.
